doc.brief: Contains the metadata associated with an item in the recently used files list.
doc.md:
Contains the metadata associated with an item in the
recently used files list.

create_app_info.md:
Creates a `GAppInfo` for the specified `GtkRecentInfo`

In case of error, `error` will be set either with a
%GTK_RECENT_MANAGER_ERROR or a %G_IO_ERROR

exists.brief: Checks whether the resource pointed by `info` still exists.
exists.md:
Checks whether the resource pointed by `info` still exists.
At the moment this check is done only on resources pointing
to local files.

get_added.brief: Gets the time when the resource was added to the recently used resources list.
get_added.md:
Gets the time when the resource
was added to the recently used resources list.

get_age.brief: Gets the number of days elapsed since the last update of the resource pointed by `info`.
get_age.md:
Gets the number of days elapsed since the last update
of the resource pointed by `info`.

get_application_info.brief: Gets the data regarding the application that has registered the resource pointed by `info`.
get_application_info.md:
Gets the data regarding the application that has registered the resource
pointed by `info`.

If the command line contains any escape characters defined inside the
storage specification, they will be expanded.

get_applications.brief: Retrieves the list of applications that have registered this resource.
get_applications.md: Retrieves the list of applications that have registered this resource.

get_description.brief: Gets the (short) description of the resource.
get_description.md: Gets the (short) description of the resource.

get_display_name.brief: Gets the name of the resource.
get_display_name.md:
Gets the name of the resource.

If none has been defined, the basename
of the resource is obtained.

get_gicon.brief: Retrieves the icon associated to the resource MIME type.
get_gicon.md: Retrieves the icon associated to the resource MIME type.

get_groups.brief: Returns all groups registered for the recently used item `info`.
get_groups.md:
Returns all groups registered for the recently used item `info`.

The array of returned group names will be `NULL` terminated, so
length might optionally be `NULL`.

get_mime_type.brief: Gets the MIME type of the resource.
get_mime_type.md: Gets the MIME type of the resource.

get_modified.brief: Gets the time when the meta-data for the resource was last modified.
get_modified.md:
Gets the time when the meta-data
for the resource was last modified.

get_private_hint.brief: Gets the value of the “private” flag.
get_private_hint.md:
Gets the value of the “private” flag.

Resources in the recently used list that have this flag
set to `TRUE` should only be displayed by the applications
that have registered them.

get_short_name.brief: Computes a valid UTF-8 string that can be used as the name of the item in a menu or list.
get_short_name.md:
Computes a valid UTF-8 string that can be used as the
name of the item in a menu or list.

For example, calling this function on an item that refers
to “file:///foo/bar.txt” will yield “bar.txt”.

get_uri.brief: Gets the URI of the resource.
get_uri.md: Gets the URI of the resource.

get_uri_display.brief: Gets a displayable version of the resource’s URI.
get_uri_display.md:
Gets a displayable version of the resource’s URI.

If the resource is local, it returns a local path; if the
resource is not local, it returns the UTF-8 encoded content
of [`RecentInfo.get_uri()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.RecentInfo#method:get_uri).

get_visited.brief: Gets the time when the meta-data for the resource was last visited.
get_visited.md:
Gets the time when the meta-data
for the resource was last visited.

has_application.brief: Checks whether an application registered this resource using `app_name`.
has_application.md: Checks whether an application registered this resource using `app_name`.

has_group.brief: Checks whether `group_name` appears inside the groups registered for the recently used item `info`.
has_group.md:
Checks whether `group_name` appears inside the groups
registered for the recently used item `info`.

is_local.brief: Checks whether the resource is local or not by looking at the scheme of its URI.
is_local.md:
Checks whether the resource is local or not by looking at the
scheme of its URI.

last_application.brief: Gets the name of the last application that have registered the recently used resource represented by `info`.
last_application.md:
Gets the name of the last application that have registered the
recently used resource represented by `info`.

match.brief: Checks whether two `GtkRecentInfo` point to the same resource.
match.md: Checks whether two `GtkRecentInfo` point to the same resource.

ref.brief: Increases the reference count of `recent_info` by one.
ref.md: Increases the reference count of `recent_info` by one.

unref.brief: Decreases the reference count of `info` by one.
unref.md:
Decreases the reference count of `info` by one.

If the reference count reaches zero, `info` is
deallocated, and the memory freed.
